name: engines
description: Compose generative loop docs live: the engines-lsp language server and the engines-live player in VS Code (ADR 0038).

engines.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to `engines-lsp`. Empty: `target/release/engines-lsp` in the workspace.

engines.skills.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Copy the Engines skills (`/engines-new`, `/engines-edit`, `/engines-song`) into the opened folder's `.claude/skills/` when the Claude Code extension is installed, since Claude Code doesn't read the skills VS Code extensions declare. A copy is refreshed each time Engines starts; delete its `.engines-copy` file to keep your own edits.

engines.live.path.markdownDescription: Path to `engines-live`. Empty: `target/release/engines-live` in the workspace.

engines.live.args.markdownDescription: Extra `engines-live` arguments, e.g. `["--output-device", "MacBook Pro Speakers"]` or `["--ring-ms", "120"]`.

engines.live.outputDevice.markdownDescription: Output device for `engines-live` (`--output-device`), e.g. a multichannel loopback such as `BlackHole 64ch`, or your headphones. Empty: the system output. **Engines: Choose the Output Device…** (or the device line in the live panel) picks it from a list and switches a playing player in place.

engines.live.routeSources.markdownDescription: Route every audio source to its own stereo pair of `engines.live.outputDevice` (`--route-sources`, ADR 0044), as the piece's routing map assigns them. Needs a multichannel device such as `BlackHole 64ch`.

engines.live.headless.markdownDescription: Run `engines-live --headless`: no audio device (the panel still shows everything).

enumDescriptions: The player hears the doc each time you save it (⌘S). Unsaved edits wait; the status bar and the panel mark them.
The player hears the editor as you type, saved or not (once the buffer has been still for `#engines.live.debounceMs#`).
engines.live.applyOn.markdownDescription: When your edits reach the player. With `save`, `files.autoSave: afterDelay` turns every pause into a save (hands-free); it's off unless you set it.

engines.live.debounceMs.markdownDescription: With `#engines.live.applyOn#` set to `edit`: how long the buffer must be still before it's sent to the player (ms).

engines.live.highlightSteps.markdownDescription: Highlight the step each step sequence is playing.

engines.inlayHints.notes.markdownDescription: Note names after offsets (`7` → `A4`) and the just-intonation harmonic after a tuned `cents_offset`.

engines.inlayHints.units.markdownDescription: What a value in its unit doesn't say: the note nearest a cutoff (`cutoff_hz: 800` → `≈G5 +35¢`), a gain's amplitude (`level_db: -6.02` → `×0.50`), a depth's swing (`depth_oct: 1` → `400Hz…1.60kHz`), a binaural pair's note and beat band.

engines.inlayHints.cycles.markdownDescription: Each modulator's cycle, and when the whole doc realigns.

engines.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic with engines-lsp (Output → Engines).
